title.narrative: Activity under preparation EU- Support measures for Civil Society and the Global Gateway Initiative in Nigeria

description.narrative: The action aims to improve collaborative engagement between the Nigerian government and implementers of global gateway interventions, to enable government work better on its policy design and implementation of important reforms in clean energy, digital technology, good governance and social inclusion. It will be implemented at national level across Nigeria, working mainly with civil society organisations and federal institutions. Where relevant, state authorities and implementers of global gateway interventions would be engaged. The Delegation will adopt a dual-pronged approach that entails:Setting up a flexible support facility that provides expert advice when needed, organises regular policy discussions, and brings together government, businesses, banks, civil society and international partners under a Team Europe approach andSupporting civil society participation in the implementation of global gateway interventions including enhancing accountability and transparency by government institutions By strengthening coordination, skills and dialogue, the action helps Nigeria attract investment, create jobs and grow its economy in a fair and sustainable way. At the same time, it increases the impact of Global Gateway investments and strengthens the EU¿Nigeria partnership, ensuring that reforms lead to real improvements in people¿s lives
